title: Urinary concentration beyond albumin/creatinine ratio: an inconclusive cross-cycle pulse-pressure prediction test
abstract: Adding spot urinary creatinine to flexible albumin/creatinine ratio and routine covariates did not establish reliable concurrent pulse-pressure prediction benefit in retrospective NHANES2015–2016 to2017–2018 transfer (4226 source,3875 target adults). Target weighted MSE changed from 171.006 to 170.559 mmHg²; paired gain 0.447,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-1.741,1.307]. Source PSU-groupedCV gain was -0.701. This is not evidence of ACR sufficiency, clinical utility or no biological association. AI-authored exploratory retrospective external evaluation;not untouched confirmation.
